annotations.title: Current time: now in any time zone

description: Current time in any time zone or city: the exact date and time now with UTC offset, weekday, zone abbreviation and Unix timestamp (UTC when no zone is given), daylight saving time handled. Use when an agent needs to know what time or date it is right now, to timestamp a record, or to check whether a place is inside business hours. Example: zone=Europe/Stockholm. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

at.description: Optional moment to convert, as ISO 8601 with an offset or Unix seconds (default: now)

to.description: Optional comma-separated time zones to convert the same moment into (max 10)

zone.description: IANA time zone or city, e.g. Europe/Stockholm, America/New_York or Tokyo (default UTC)

name: time_now
title: Current time: now in any time zone
